title: Data-Driven MPC with Adaptively Sampled Non-Expert Demonstrations: Performance Guarantees and Sample Complexity
summary: We study data-driven policy construction for dynamical systems using trajectories generated by surrogate finite-horizon Model Predictive Control (MPC), with the goal of approximating an infinite-horizon optimal control policy. We interpret these trajectories as non-expert demonstrations and propose a memory-based, nonparametric policy that constructs a Lipschitz-regularized upper envelope of the finite- horizon surrogate value function, which serves as an explicit upper bound on the value of the resulting policy, thereby providing a computable performance certificate while bypassing explicit…
